html:
The Awarai, or Warray, are an Aboriginal people of the Northern Territory, in country along the upper Adelaide River south of Darwin.

Their neighbours were the Kungarakany to the north, the Wagiman to the south and the Jawoyn to the east. In the 1870s the building of the Overland Telegraph Line and a gold rush around Pine Creek brought miners, many of them Chinese, into this country. The Warray language is now barely spoken. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: The Awarai, or Warray, are an Aboriginal people of the Northern Territory, in country along the upper Adelaide River south of Darwin.
